newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Malaysian firm seeks joint venture in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian firm seeks joint venture in Philippines.

text.p: Peninsula Securities Sdn Bhd said on Saturday it was seeking a partner for the establishment of a stock brokerage firm in Manila.
Peninsula Securities said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) it was "keen to establish a presence in the capital market in the Philippines."

"Towards this end, we write to explore with the esteemed members of the PSE the possibility of acquiring a seat on the PSE or enter into a joint venture with any of the members of the PSE," the Malaysian firm said.
